info.description:
Shift management. Recurring shift templates (day of week + time range) and
volunteer bookings against them — see docs/adr/0025-modello-dati-turni.md in
the repository. The resource endpoints themselves are still being rebuilt on
top of this model (see docs/backlog.md); only /healthz and /docs/ exist today.
info.title: Sanitas — Shifts API

BearerAuth.description:
shifts issues no tokens itself — type "Bearer" followed by a space and
the access token obtained from registry's POST /v1/login (e.g. "Bearer eyJhbGci...").
BearerAuth.name: Authorization
